title: Health insurer claim extraction
narrative: A claims platform extracts a fixed JSON object from an explanation-of-benefits packet: member id, service date, billed amount, allowed amount, and denial code. The caller waits for the object. Amounts may be off by one cent. The packet contains PHI.
teaching_points: End-to-end latency is the speed metric. Time to first token does not matter, because the caller cannot use a partial object.
JSON schema validity is both a quality term and a gate at 0.99. Raw JSON parse is not a second gate.
Dollar fields are scored with numeric tolerance and should be left out of the exact field-accuracy denominator so they are not counted twice.
PHI leakage is a gate on a confirmed set. It is not averaged into quality.

title: Fintech support chat
narrative: A streaming support assistant answers account questions in the company's voice. A help-center knowledge base is retrieved when the agent decides it is relevant, but the product is not a system of record. Candidates include reasoning models. The assistant must refuse crimes and scams, must not refuse ordinary balance questions, and must not give personalized financial advice.
teaching_points: The catalogue's default rubric is not selected. Answer relevancy, brand fit, and faithfulness already name the constructs.
Faithfulness is a quality term, not a gate. The knowledge base is optional context, not the legal record.
Harmful compliance, over-refusal, and the advice boundary are the three risk gates. A finance bot that refuses every question looks safe and is useless.
Time to first token ranks speed. Time to first answer token is reported beside it when reasoning models are in the set, and it is not a second ranking axis.
notes: Faithfulness is in the quality average and is not a gate, because grounding is not a hard product requirement.
ttfat_ms is reported for reasoning models and is not the ranking speed metric.

title: Nightly ad-copy batch
narrative: A job writes product blurbs overnight. Editors read them in the morning. Copy must sound like the brand, must not name competitors, and must stay inside a character window. Monthly volume is known. Nobody is waiting on a token.
teaching_points: Batch does not rank on time to first token or end-to-end latency. The speed weight in the product profile is zero.
Competitor names and the length window are deterministic. Brand fit is the only judged quality metric.
Cost per successful case is the cost used for ranking. Monthly cost is reported because a volume was entered. It is not a second cost axis.
notes: No speed metric is ranked. The caller is not waiting on the response.

title: Coding agent
narrative: An agent edits a repository through tools, runs the project's tests, and may open a pull request. Several tool sequences can be legal. Arguments must match the tool schema before anything executes. Generated code can be merged, so insecure patterns matter. The team cares that a task succeeds every time, not once in eight samples.
teaching_points: Tool-call match, tool choice, tests, and task success are the quality average. A trajectory is not exact-matched, because more than one path is legal.
Argument-schema validity is the catalogue's tool-argument gate, under a more precise id than json_valid. It does not also enter the quality average.
pass^k is reported for reliability and is not averaged into quality, so a flaky success is not double-counted with task success.
The speed metric is task wall time, not time to first token.
notes: pass_hat_k is reported for agent reliability and does not enter Q.

title: Legal contract RAG
narrative: An internal tool answers questions about a contract the firm uploaded. Answers must be supported by the retrieved clauses, must cite them, and must say when the contract is silent. Retrieval quality is in scope. The tool is not a public chatbot.
teaching_points: Five quality metrics fill the cap: faithfulness, citation precision, citation recall, unknown abstention, and context recall.
Answer relevancy is the first metric that did not fit. It is the alternate to add if citations are later dropped.
Faithfulness at or above 0.9 is the grounding gate. Hallucination rate is the same construct in gate form and is not added beside it.
Context recall is included because retrieval is being judged. It would be omitted if the context were frozen by the client.
notes: The quality cap is 5. First alternate: answer_relevancy.
Hallucination rate was not added. Faithfulness is already the grounding measurement.
